note: Inventory rows whose control the shipped Charts product does not have (reviewed by hand against source, 2026-11-09, TEACH-WATCHLISTS-WIDGET-DESIGN.md group C). Counted as NOT IN PRODUCT, never as a missing walkthrough. A row leaves this file the day its control ships.

rows.C3-066: Colour-tag lists are rendered only by the unscoped Watchlists page (!pickList), and /watchlists redirects to Charts; the widget's list picker has no tag lists.
rows.C3-081: No control in the product: Watchlists.jsx never starts a row drag (dragItemId is never set), so a ticker cannot be reordered by hand.
rows.C3-084: Column presets (COL_PRESETS) are rendered only in the unscoped page's sub-header (!pickList); the widget's column menu has none.
rows.C3-089: The widget shows one list, always open: there is nothing to expand or collapse. ‹ Lists switches the list.
rows.C3-090: Not in the Charts Watchlist widget (counted NOT IN PRODUCT for the widget family): a ticker’s colour tag lives on the ticker action menu (components/TickerActions.jsx, opened from TickerPopup and from ticker lists on other pages: the Calendar, the Screener’s results, Theme Tracker, the Desk reader), which the widget does not open.
rows.C3-080: No way to star a ticker in a list: the list menu’s Remove starred shows only while a list has starred tickers, and nothing in the product stars one (pages/Watchlists.jsx toggleStar is never called; a row’s ☆ is Add to Flagged).
